work_packages.name: Repository and governance scaffold
work_packages.acceptance: Monorepo skeleton, owners, branch rules, generated-file policy and fast empty CI lanes exist; no production claim.

work_packages.name: Contract/schema v1 implementation
work_packages.acceptance: All I-01..I-22 have machine schemas/enums, compatibility tests and generated bindings; S2 fields match exactly.

work_packages.name: Import and harden Android acquisition
work_packages.acceptance: Existing S1 path builds in monorepo; raw clocks/axes/provenance round-trip into verified sessions.

work_packages.name: Canonical C++ core and JNI integration
work_packages.acceptance: S2 tests and C++/NumPy parity pass; JNI batch fixture produces identical accepted/rejected evidence and state.

work_packages.name: Deterministic replay backbone
work_packages.acceptance: A public synthetic session replays deterministically through live-compatible input contracts with clear REPLAY label.

work_packages.name: Complete S1 physical-device protocol
work_packages.acceptance: Named device sessions and analyzer outputs adjudicate rate, gap, screen-off, battery and thermal gates without generalizing beyond devices.

work_packages.name: S3 alignment and mount-slip spike
work_packages.acceptance: Predeclared controlled car tests select or reject a method; alignment covariance/status contract is exercised; failure disables dependent aids.

work_packages.name: GNSS integrity/outage/reacquisition
work_packages.acceptance: Good, biased, stale and intermittent return fixtures prove no first-fix privilege, evidence-once semantics and continuous typed modes.

work_packages.name: Runtime graph store and top-K matcher
work_packages.acceptance: Frozen S6B1 graph verifies, clear/ambiguous/off-road fixtures meet frozen logical gates, and matcher can abstain.

work_packages.name: Offline navigation UI and honest telemetry
work_packages.acceptance: Airplane-mode replay shows local map, traces, uncertainty, candidates and mandatory mode labels; attribution visible.

work_packages.name: Private IO-VNBD ingestion and leakage firewall
work_packages.acceptance: Pinned private subset manifest, six-schema handling, dedup/group split and runtime-vs-label canary checks pass; no raw bytes enter repo.

work_packages.name: Classical baselines and bounded learned aid
work_packages.acceptance: Matched baseline/ablation on frozen split and masks; results labelled exploratory; no claim or release beyond rights/evidence.

work_packages.name: Model export and Android shadow mode
work_packages.acceptance: Golden parity, deadline/OOD/bounds and disabled fallback pass; shadow-mode decisions logged before influence is enabled.

work_packages.name: Integrated analyzer and claim firewall
work_packages.acceptance: Reports separate raw INS, fused, matched, display and reference; compute endpoint/max/RMSE/rates/transitions and reject invalid provenance.

work_packages.name: Calibration/constraints classical baseline
work_packages.acceptance: Model-disabled car replay/live path produces bounded typed outputs; alignment-dependent constraints are gated and ablatable.

work_packages.name: Ten-event deterministic demonstration
work_packages.acceptance: Script shows valid GNSS, simulated outage, turn, uncertainty growth, candidates, biased-return rejection, credible acceptance, smooth display recovery and after-run comparison.

work_packages.name: External IMU adapter and rate profiling
work_packages.acceptance: Documented adapter replays external-format data; input/propagation/output rates reported separately; no universal 200 Hz claim.

work_packages.name: Release verification and field rehearsal
work_packages.acceptance: Clean build/install, network-isolated replay/live rehearsal, privacy/licence/secret scan and artifact hashes pass; field route separately approved or replay-only.
